item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 13 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 13 #VISPRSD
Issued at 03:07 PM 25 August 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Cebu(CebuCity, Compostela, Liloan, Consolacion, MandaueCity, CityOfTalisay, Minglanilla), #NegrosOccidental(CityOfEscalante, SanEnrique, Valladolid, LaCarlotaCity, BagoCity, SanCarlosCity, SalvadorBenedicto, Murcia, BacolodCity and CityOfTalisay) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Cebu(Catmon), #NegrosOccidental(Pulupandan, Toboso and Calatrava) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
